Each claim is tagged according to its disposition, which reflects either implementation in the repo, boundary-only existence, or speculative status. This creates a lattice of claim states that can be mapped into GSI’s Bayesian framework for belief updating and GSE’s state machine for operational planning. The core duality lies between deterministic implementation (IMPLEMENTED) and probabilistic speculation (QUEUED-BUILDABLE), with failure modes including misclassification due to incorrect path resolution or duplicate claims. The system must maintain consistency across these layers to avoid logical contradictions in downstream reasoning.
